messages:
maria: heads up — post-deploy canary for rlhf-quant-path started at 1767777777, I'm seeing a sharp jump in 5xxs and >p95 latency on the embed/route. Canary traffic is 2%.
incident-bot: :rotating_light: PagerDuty alert fired: PD_INCIDENT_4721 - canary: rlhf-quant-path - elevated 5xx rate. Pager: @pagerduty oncall.
pagerduty-bot: PagerDuty incident created and paged: https://pd.example/incidents/4721 — please ack or escalate per runbook.
aj: acked via PD, I'm on it. Pulling canary logs.
henry: oncall-sre here — moving traffic down to 0% for that canary while we triage. Lina, can you confirm rollback trigger?
lina: Rolling the canary to 0% now (policy: immediate on >3% 5xx increase). Command run: `redwood rollout scale --target rlhf-quant-path --canary 0`
paul: seeing repeated kernel OOMs in the quant runtime on the canary hosts, matches the p95 spikes. stack traces pointing at kv-cache expansion.
maria: timeline: deploy finished +2m -> anomalies at +6m. Impact: ~3.5% of host customers routed through the canary path see degraded responses (timeouts ~7s) and some 502s. Putting customer-impact label: partial-degradation, not system-wide.
aj: collecting flamegraphs, attaching snapshot: `s3://redwood-incidents/4721/flame-17677778.tar.gz`
henry: creating bridge for post-mortem, tagging C-level notification request. Bridge: https://meet.example/bridge/4721
lina: quick mitigation — forcing quant kernel to fallback to FP16 path for canary models to avoid the OOM. Deploying patch to canary only.
incident-bot: PD incident 4721 status: acknowledged by aj — escalation paused. If no progress in 15m will auto-escalate to secondary.
paul: patch applied to 2/3 canary nodes. Observed immediate drop in OOMs on those nodes. Still seeing 5xx from one host (ip-10-0-3-21).
maria: we're going to cordon that host and drain it. aj, can you coordinate cordon?
aj: cordon+drain done: `k8s drain ip-10-0-3-21 --ignore-daemonsets --grace-period=30` Host removed from load balancer. 5xxs dropping in metrics.
henry: traffic back to 2% canary as a validation step. Monitoring p95 and 5xx for 10m.
lina: if stable after validation, we will resume normal rollout with quant-fallback flag enabled and open a follow-up for a full rollback if necessary.
maria: customer impact update: affected sessions ~0.02% of total requests during spike window; no lasting data corruption reported. Notifying support to triage any inbound tickets.
pagerduty-bot: Incident 4721 — status changed to: monitoring (acknowledged, mitigation applied).
aj: adding reproduction steps to the ticket: 1) deploy rlhf-quant-path on small canary 2) run synthetic KV-heavy workloads with long contexts 3) observe OOM on quant kernel.
paul: postmortem task created: https://pm.example/tasks/rlhf-quant-oom-postmortem — owners: paul, lina, maria. Due: 72h.
maria: decision: no global rollback required, mitigation applied and verified. Keeping incident open for postmortem items and follow-up patch to the quant runtime. Will update stakeholders. :white_check_mark:
henry: oncall handoff in 40m to night team — I'll include status summary in the handoff.
aj: closing bridge in 5, leaving pagerduty incident open for follow-up.
incident-bot: Bridge closed by henry.
maria: thanks everyone — great coordination. We'll publish a short incident note to #incidents-summary after the postmortem draft is ready.
